# Sessions and Revenue by Gender

This report compares the sessions and revenue of male and female players.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

gender <- read.csv("KPIsperGender.csv")

ggplot(gender, aes(x = Gender, y = SessionsPerPlayer)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Sessions per Player by Gender", x = "Gender", y = "Sessions per Player") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(gender, aes(x = Gender, y = ARPU)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "ARPU by Gender", x = "Gender", y = "ARPU") +
  theme_minimal()
```
